item.title: Week 10: 49ers at Cowboys
item.description: Sun 11/15 · 4:25 PM ET | Line: SF -4.5 · O/U 55.5 | Model DAL 41% vs. market 36% | On paper San Francisco has the edge, led by its passing offense, ranked 5th of 32 in EPA per dropback (+0.25), while Dallas' best counter is pressure, ranked 4th at 23% versus San Francisco's 3rd at 21%. Purdy ranks 4th of 31 in EPA per dropback to Prescott's 7th, and CeeDee Lamb, who draws 35% of Dallas' targets and 43% of its air yards, is the x-factor against a San Francisco pass defense ranked 6th. The model favors San Francisco at 59%, driven by a passing matchup worth 1.9 points and a rushing matchup worth 1.2.
